title: A letter at the shop door
paragraphs: Your parent ran this herb shop for many years. It sells jamu and salep.
Your parent left on an expedition and did not come back. The shop is now yours.
The shop also has a large riba debt. The interest grows every month.
Plan each week. Make good products. Keep a buffer. Pay at the end of each month.
You have two months. Then the guild will look at your books with you.
